objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-binary-proxy-execution-mavinject-dll-injection
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of mavinject.exe for DLL injection into running processes, identified by specific command-line parameters such as /INJECTRUNNING and /HMODULE. This detection leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions.
